description: Each week AI models (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and others) and a coin flip pick which of two AI infrastructure stocks will have the higher price return over the week, locked before the first open and settled on price after the last close. Returns one week: each pair's stocks and returns, the shared briefing, and every model's pick, confidence, reasoning and result (null until the pair settles). Defaults to the latest week. Use when the question is what a model picked, why, or how it did on one pair. For the running record use get_ai_matchup_standings. Supercycle does not pick: the models do. Picks are AI-generated forecasts, not investment advice, and the models have no portfolios.

week.description: The week's key: the date of its first session (YYYY-MM-DD), as listed in data.weekKeys. Default the latest week.

name: get_ai_matchup_week
